label: Time of Day / Atmosphere
description: The hour and its air — each item paints light temperature, shadow length and sky character.

items.name: summer-sundown
items.text: early sundown during summer, long soft shadows stretching across the ground and warm amber light wrapping every surface

items.name: golden-hour
items.text: deep golden hour, the low sun turning the air honey-colored and edging every contour with glow

items.name: midday-clear
items.text: bright midday under a cloudless cobalt sky, short hard shadows and maximum color saturation

items.name: morning-mist
items.text: early morning with delicate mist rising off the ground, pale gold light diffusing through the haze

items.name: blue-hour
items.text: blue hour after sunset, the sky a deep luminous cobalt while artificial lights switch on warm against it

items.name: night-clear
items.text: a crystal-clear night, star-pricked black sky and cool ambient moonglow

items.name: midnight-city-glow
items.text: deep midnight, the scene lit only by scattered artificial sources burning against darkness

items.name: first-light
items.text: the first minutes of dawn, a thin rose-and-silver band on the horizon and the world still half asleep in cool shadow

items.name: stormlight
items.text: eerie pre-storm light, sun breaking under charcoal clouds and igniting the scene against a near-black sky

items.name: hazy-afternoon
items.text: a hazy late afternoon, sunlight scattered soft through suspended dust and warmth

items.name: moonlit
items.text: full moonlight silvering every edge, deep blue shadow pools and quiet monochrome calm

items.name: overcast-noon
items.text: flat overcast noon, shadowless even grey light rendering true colors and textures
